reaction.trapRisk: The trap is a gap-up on a good NVDA number while VIX is still above 25: NVDA was oversold at $153.55 live (RSI 21.9), so a relief gap is likely and can fail within days. Entries wait for VIX back under 25, the failure-zone retest verdict, and a second low that holds — never the gap-up open.

strategyPosture: Watch, leaning stand-down. No new money: VIX is 25.7 intraday, above the 25 stand-down line, and SPY implies SPX below its 200-day hours before NVDA reports; both triggers are close-based, so the stand-down trips only if they hold into the close. Hold existing positions and do not average down in the leveraged names.

themes.counterRead: Both triggers are close-based, so neither has tripped yet; a late-day reversal leaves the ladder where it was. But a close with VIX above 25 and SPX below its 200-day would trip two rungs at once, before the NVDA number lands — the stand-down then governs regardless of how the print reads.
